**Coaching note:**
The bishop on e2 is undefended—a key weakness. By playing Nxe2+ with check, you win the bishop immediately because the king must move. Your queen then captures the rook on c1 with another check, winning massive material. Always scan for undefended pieces, especially when you can capture them with check or tempo—this forces your opponent to react.
